page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c9ae.8xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing AMD EPYC 9T95 processors running at a clock speed of 2.25 GHz. The instance is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core.

This server does not include local storage or bundled GPUs, requiring external block storage for operating system and application data. It provides a baseline network bandwidth of 16 Gbps to support network-dependent workloads. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing capabilities without resource contention from other tenants.

Given its 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and dedicated AMD EPYC processing cores, this instance is designed for compute-heavy workloads. It is suitable for tasks such as high-traffic web serving, batch processing, distributed analytics, and compilation workloads where CPU performance is prioritized over large memory footprints.
